title: Teams Telephony - Simply Explained

entities.name: Mirko Peters
entities.quote: I'm Mirko Peters from M365FM, and I'll see you in the next episode.

entities.name: Compliance
entities.quote: Compliance is another area where Teams phone shines.

entities.name: Multifactor authentication (MFA)
entities.quote: So if you have multi-factor authentication enabled and you should, your phone system is protected by the same security.

entities.name: GDPR

entities.name: Teams Phone

entities.name: Microsoft Teams
entities.quote: You've probably seen the phone icon in Teams and wondered if you can actually make a call from there.

quotes.text: Teams Telephony is that same switchboard, but it lives in Microsoft's cloud and follows you everywhere. Your phone number is no longer tied to a physical location. It's tied to you.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Captures the core shift from desk-bound hardware to a cloud phone system.

quotes.text: The real world cost can be two to three times the headline license price once you add calling minutes and support.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A practical warning against judging Teams Phone costs by the license price alone.

quotes.text: Your phone system is now as secure as the rest of your Microsoft 365 environment. You don't need a separate security setup for your phones.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Addresses the common security concern about moving telephony to the cloud.

quotes.text: Start small. Don't try to move your entire company at once. Pick a handful of users to pilot your new setup. Set up an auto attendant for your main number. Test it for a week.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concrete, low-risk rollout advice for adopting Teams Phone.

quotes.text: The magic isn't any single feature. It's how they all connect to make your work life easier.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Summarizes why the integrated feature set matters more than individual features.

chapters.title: Intro: the phone icon in Teams
How it connects and next steps

takeaways: Teams Telephony is a cloud PBX built into Microsoft Teams that ties your phone number to you instead of a desk.
You need a Teams Phone license plus one of three connection options: Microsoft Calling Plans, Operator Connect or Direct Routing.
Check your existing license, get a full quote including calling minutes and support, and start with a small pilot group.
hook: Old desk phone systems are expensive, rigid and tied to one location. This episode explains Teams Telephony in plain English for small businesses and IT decision-makers: what it is, how it connects to the phone network, what it really costs and which features replace a traditional PBX.
